## What you want to do

The problem, not the solution: what is awkward or missing today.

## What it would look like

A command, a tab, a key, a line in the profile.

## Does it pass the four tests?

The screen does not invade the room; quick access to what matters; moving between
devices without drama; what you left on one device is there on the next.
(See CONTRIBUTING.md. Things that are only yours belong in your profile.)
